correctness.rationale: All geometric points of each fibre are controlled by the derivative-sum and binary-axis identities. The local blowup expansion gives four unibranch delta-one cusps, and the exceptional axis quadratic gives exactly six ordinary nodes. Bezout and node incidence force irreducibility at all non-endpoint parameters. The two endpoint factorizations and intersection graphs are checked using divisor classes on a four-point blowup. Critical characteristic-three polynomial identities and line incidences are replayed by verify.py.
